steps.command:
cd /workspace/fio || exit 1
chmod +x fio
echo '4986f10f2072a20e1dd1b7c31311b14610b1174235410a11491167953e655ddb  fio' | sha256sum -c - || exit 1
dd if=/dev/zero of=probe bs=4k count=256 oflag=direct status=none || { echo 'direct write refused'; exit 1; }
dd if=probe of=/dev/null bs=4k iflag=direct status=none || { echo 'direct read refused'; exit 1; }
rm -f probe
free=$(df -B1 --output=avail . | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
[ "$free" -ge {param:free_bytes} ] || { echo "not enough free disk: $free"; exit 1; }
cat > disk.fio <<'JOBFILE'
; One job file for the four disk benchmarks. RW, BS, SIZE, IODEPTH, RAMP and RUNTIME come from the
; environment, which the workload parameters set.
; fio 3.39 reads text after an option, a ';' included, as part of the option's value,
; so every comment here has a line of its own.
[global]
; Linux native asynchronous I/O, so iodepth requests can be in flight
ioengine=libaio
; O_DIRECT: bypass the guest page cache
direct=1
; requests in flight (decided: Andre, 2026-10-09; section 3, choice 1)
iodepth=${IODEPTH}
; one process
numjobs=1
filename=/workspace/fio/data.bin
; the data file (decided: Andre, 2026-10-09; section 3, choice 3)
size=${SIZE}
; seconds run before the measured interval, not counted
ramp_time=${RAMP}
; the measured interval, in seconds
runtime=${RUNTIME}
; repeat over the file until runtime ends
time_based=1
; drop the file's cached pages before starting (fio's default, written out)
invalidate=1
; no sync calls (fio's defaults, written out)
fsync=0
end_fsync=0
; the same random offsets every trial (fio's default, written out)
randrepeat=1
; fresh random contents for every write buffer: no repeated or compressible blocks;
; the CPU this costs is in usr_cpu (1.7, item 5)
refill_buffers=1
group_reporting=1
; one throughput and IOPS sample per second
log_avg_msec=1000
write_bw_log=/workspace/fio/log
write_iops_log=/workspace/fio/log
per_job_logs=0

[disk]
rw=${RW}
bs=${BS}
JOBFILE
echo '{param:job_file_sha256}  disk.fio' | sha256sum -c - || exit 1

steps.script: cd /workspace/fio && RW=read BS=1m SIZE={param:file_bytes} IODEPTH={param:queue_depth} RAMP={param:ramp_seconds} RUNTIME={param:runtime_seconds} ./fio --output-format=terse --eta=never disk.fio; rc=$?; rm -f /workspace/fio/log_*; exit $rc

cd /workspace/fio && RW=write BS=1m SIZE={param:file_bytes} IODEPTH={param:queue_depth} RAMP={param:ramp_seconds} RUNTIME={param:runtime_seconds} ./fio --output-format=terse --eta=never disk.fio; rc=$?; rm -f /workspace/fio/log_*; exit $rc

cd /workspace/fio && RW=randread BS=4k SIZE={param:file_bytes} IODEPTH={param:queue_depth} RAMP={param:ramp_seconds} RUNTIME={param:runtime_seconds} ./fio --output-format=terse --eta=never disk.fio; rc=$?; rm -f /workspace/fio/log_*; exit $rc

cd /workspace/fio && RW=randwrite BS=4k SIZE={param:file_bytes} IODEPTH={param:queue_depth} RAMP={param:ramp_seconds} RUNTIME={param:runtime_seconds} ./fio --output-format=terse --eta=never disk.fio; rc=$?; rm -f /workspace/fio/log_*; exit $rc

cd /workspace/fio || exit 1
f="./fio --output-format=terse --eta=never --filename=cache.bin --size={param:cache_probe_bytes}"
$f --name=a --rw=write --bs=1m --ioengine=psync --direct=0 --end_fsync=1 > /dev/null || exit 1
$f --name=b --rw=read --bs=1m --ioengine=psync --direct=0 --invalidate=0 || exit 1
$f --name=c --rw=read --bs=1m --ioengine=libaio --iodepth={param:queue_depth} --direct=1 || exit 1
python3 - <<'CHECK'
import hashlib, sys, zlib
data = open('data.bin', 'rb').read(64 << 20)
blocks = len(data) // 4096
distinct = len({hashlib.sha256(data[i:i + 4096]).digest() for i in range(0, len(data), 4096)})
ratio = len(zlib.compress(data, 1)) / len(data)
print('blocks', blocks, 'distinct', distinct, 'zlib_ratio', ratio)
sys.exit(0 if distinct >= blocks * 0.999 and ratio >= {param:min_zlib_ratio} else 1)
CHECK
